title: Console renders a plain boolean field set to false as a red "<label> — 已关闭" badge
body:
## What happens

On the same object, two plain `Field.boolean` fields render differently when their value is `false`:

```ts
is_mandatory: Field.boolean({ label: '必备资质', group: 'review', defaultValue: false }),
verified:     Field.boolean({ label: '已核验',   group: 'review', defaultValue: false }),
```

- `is_mandatory` renders as a checkbox icon, which is correct.
- `verified` renders as a red danger badge reading **「已核验 — 已关闭」**. This happens in the list view and on the record detail page.

The badge reads as an error ("verified — closed"). The value only means "not verified yet", which is the default state of every new record.

## Repro

- `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0, `objectstack dev`, locale zh-CN.
- App: objectstack-ai/hotsrm `main`, object `srm_supplier_certificate`, default list view with a `verified` column.
- Create any certificate and leave 已核验 off.
- Open the list: the 已核验 column shows the red 「已核验 — 已关闭」 badge.

## Expected

A boolean field renders the same way whatever its name: a checkbox or check mark, with an empty or neutral state for false. It should not use a danger-colored badge. If some name-based heuristic is picking this rendering (for example `verified` treated as a status), metadata should be able to turn it off.
